data.title: 拉普兰德 · 雨夜断桥的孤狼凝睇
data.action: 懒散地倚在斑驳水泥栏杆上，白狼尾巴在身后轻扫，一手拨弄着湿润银发，苍白脸颊上带着狂野而慵懒的笑意，眼底跳动着危险的狂热火苗。
data.location: 叙拉古废弃安全屋屋顶露台，雨后湿漉的地面映出远处街道的昏红灯火
data.lighting: 雨雾弥漫中远方猩红霓虹灯的背光散射，在白发与白皙肌肤上勾勒出冷冽剪影
data.mood: 危险、野性、不羁却又带着宿命般的致命吸引力
data.description: 叙拉古废弃安全屋屋顶露台，雨后湿漉的地面映出远处街道的昏红灯火。懒散地倚在斑驳水泥栏杆上，白狼尾巴在身后轻扫，一手拨弄着湿润银发，苍白脸颊上带着狂野而慵懒的笑意，眼底跳动着危险的狂热火苗。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哈哈……这么快就找过来了？看到我穿成这副样子，你眼里的那点克制……还能撑多久？”
data.promptProse: Leaning lazily against the concrete rooftop parapet of an abandoned Siracusan safehouse after midnight rain, Lappland wears a distressed charcoal silk single-strap slip dress cinched with a narrow black leather belt. Running one hand carelessly through her rain-damp silver hair while her wolf tail sways behind her, she turns a wild, mocking smirk toward the viewer as crimson neon city lights shimmer across wet puddles on the rooftop.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against the rain-slicked rooftop railing in her single-strap charcoal silk slip dress and narrow leather belt, Lappland combs damp hair back with a wild, teasing smirk. Misty crimson neon streetlights reflect off puddles across the dark Siracusan terrace.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a charcoal-black asymmetrical single-strap raw-edge silk slip dress cinched with a narrow black leather belt and high sheer side slits over her bare shoulders and legs.
